description: Is the business underpriced? Uses sales close rate (80%+ = way underpriced, ~30% = about right, under 25% = sales problem) to suggest a price range, and computes the profit multiple of a price rise after losing some customers, plus the break-even customer loss.

closeRate.description: Percent of proposals or sales calls that close.

customersLost.description: Percent of customers expected to leave after the rise. Default 20.

newPriceMultiple.description: New price as a multiple of the old (1.5 = +50%). Default 1.5.

name: price_headroom_check
title: Price headroom from close rate
